originality.rationale: The proposed claim is the trichotomy by the disagreement graph, the c0 collapse under properness, and exact approximation-number plateaus; the generic row-tail estimate is explicitly acknowledged as background. Allen–Pons (2022) proves single-symbol essential norms, not their difference; Albanese–Mele (2023) treats individual composition operators on continuous-function scales, not an edge matching criterion; holomorphic-function results do not supply independently arbitrary atomic evaluations. Four focused published-finding corpus searches found no statement directly or through a checked stronger result giving the graph trichotomy. A hidden earlier matrix formulation remains possible, so originality is qualified, not established independently.

value.rationale: The sharp 0/1/2 classification identifies precisely when cancellations between two bounded discrete composition operators leave a noncompact but only half-maximal essential norm. The condition is the natural finite vertex-cover/infinite-matching dichotomy of the symbol disagreement graph, not a tailored numeric slice. The same property disappears for proper symbols on c0, and all approximation numbers stabilize exactly at the corresponding value with explicit rank bound. This distinguishes operator-ideal behavior of bounded versus vanishing coordinate spaces and yields complete structural criteria.
